The image shows a large steel mixing bowl, probably about 28-30 cm across, holding cubed tofu or chicken with shredded carrot and red onion. The food looks like a mound roughly 15 cm across and 5 cm tall, which is about 400 g.

The cubes look like tofu, possibly with some shredded cheese (the flaky pieces in the center look like parmesan). Chicken breast would be about 165 kcal per 100 g and firm tofu about 100 kcal per 100 g.

Assuming mostly tofu and a bit of cheese, I estimate about 350 g total at roughly 1.4 kcal/g, which gives about 450 kcal. The pale cubes could also be chicken, which would make the dish more caloric. I'll settle on about 400 kcal for about 300 g.
